principle: Old scars exist if authored and approved; screens and suites evolve; the Last Field has the same maintained geometry and no catastrophic foundation damage.

perimeter_ruins.name: The Old Ring
perimeter_ruins.narrative: An obsolete ring and benches, preserved as a visible memory of an earlier manner of trial; no verified League playoff is assigned here under Founder round law.

perimeter_ruins.name: Veterans' Yard
perimeter_ruins.narrative: Cracked old practice markers and an overgrown spectator bank are preserved instead of polished into a new final venue.

perimeter_ruins.name: Abandoned Tide Causeway Trial
perimeter_ruins.narrative: An unsafe training route lies beside—not replacing—the monumental current causeway; it is a background ruin, not a public passage.

perimeter_ruins.name: The Powder Berm
perimeter_ruins.terrain: scraped rock berm behind a closed tactical yard
perimeter_ruins.narrative: Darkened gravel, blast panels and dismantled smoke-effect frames suggest staged explosive spectacles. No precise historic detonation is asserted without approved state event.

perimeter_ruins.name: The Sunken Course
perimeter_ruins.terrain: flooded masonry labyrinth on low island edge
perimeter_ruins.narrative: A retired challenge maze with standing brackish water and plants reclaiming its former lanes; no contestant casually enters it.

perimeter_ruins.name: The Fallen Gallery
perimeter_ruins.terrain: rock ledge with collapsed roof timbers
perimeter_ruins.narrative: An old viewing structure awaiting survey and preservation, with all ticket routes diverted around it.

perimeter_ruins.name: Rusted Oval
perimeter_ruins.terrain: gravel racing circuit beyond current arena fence
perimeter_ruins.narrative: Rust-stained barriers and stripped-out engines recall a changing taste for wheeled speed without pretending dirt bikes existed in 2015.

perimeter_ruins.name: The Silent Crescent
perimeter_ruins.narrative: Broken-but-locked target mounts sit behind a collapsed protective retaining wall, not freely accessible among spectators.

perimeter_ruins.name: The Empty Fort
perimeter_ruins.terrain: weathered mock-fort walls behind an inspection fence
perimeter_ruins.narrative: A defunct nonlethal war-game set retains splattered panels and abandoned ramparts. Its date and original use remain fictional candidates.

years.theme: Founding terraces and the permanent Last Field ceremonial gates are first represented in the recovered championship archive.
